text.en: The version 3 morphology deposit places Ansonia latiffi under Ansonia (Bufonidae; Anura) and retains 2 measurement rows with 12 populated trait fields. Source row 417 (sex code F (female category)) contains entries in `SVL`, `TL`, `HL`; Source row 416 (sex code M (male category)) contains entries in `SVL`, `TL`, `HL`. Absolute units are not confirmed in the deposit, so the recorded dimension values are not used here as a species-wide size range.

title.en: How does the deposit classify this entry?

text.en: The version 3 Amphibian database lists Boophis albilabris in a source measurement table. Its classification fields read order = Anura, family = Mantellidae, genus = Boophis; the linked citation is in Reference.csv row 81. The source record marks its mapping to current COL26.8 as unresolved, so this table entry is not a complete species account.

text.en: Anura.csv rows 728, 729 contain 2 measurement entries; the Sex field records M (male category), F (female category). The source lists 2 table rows; it does not identify unique specimens, so the row count is not an animal count. The populated source codes include SVL: row 728 (M) = 87.82, row 729 (F) = 82.8; HL: row 728 (M) = 28.92, row 729 (F) = 30.15; HW: row 728 (M) = 30.9, row 729 (F) = 30.25; other populated codes are ED, TD, IND, EN, NS, HAL, LAL, FL, TL, HLL. These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.

The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. text.en: Amphibian morphology version 3 records Cycloramphus acangatan under Cycloramphus; family Cycloramphidae; order Anura. The match to a current COL26.8 species concept remains unresolved, so this page describes the deposited classification rather than making a new taxonomic determination.

title.en: 2 measurement rows and 10 populated trait fields

text.en: The source-bound locator is Anura.csv, rows 1454, 1455; Reference.csv rows 3621; the deposit contains 2 measurement rows and 1 bibliography row. Sex values recorded: M, F. In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 10 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; IOD; EN; HAL; TL; THL; IMT. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

title.en: How does the deposit classify this entry?

text.en: The version 3 Amphibian database lists Elachistocleis piauiensis in a source measurement table. Its classification fields read order = Anura, family = Microhylidae, genus = Elachistocleis; the linked citation is in Reference.csv row 416. The source record marks its mapping to current COL26.8 as unresolved, so this table entry is not a complete species account.
text.zh: 第 3 版 Amphibian database 将 Elachistocleis piauiensis 列入来源测量表。其分类字段原样写作 order = Anura, family = Microhylidae, genus = Elachistocleis；关联引文见 Reference.csv 第 416 行。来源记录将其与当前 COL26.8 的映射标为“unresolved”，因此这不是完整的物种描述。

title.zh: 记录了哪些测量代码？

text.en: Anura.csv row 1631 contain 1 measurement entry; the Sex field records M (male category). The source lists 1 table rows; it does not identify unique specimens, so the row count is not an animal count. The populated source codes include SVL: row 1631 (M) = 22.5; HL: row 1631 (M) = 3.2; HW: row 1631 (M) = 5.8; other populated codes are IOD, IND, UEW, EN, TL, THL. These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.

In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 13 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; IOD; IND; EN; HAL; FLL; FL; TL; THL; IMT. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

title.en: 1 measurement row and 18 populated trait fields

In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 18 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; TD; ETD; IOD; IND; UEW; EN; SL; HAL; FL; TL; THL; TSL; Fin3DW; Toe4DW. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

title.en: How does the deposit classify this entry?
title.zh: 存档如何归类这条记录？

text.en: The version 3 Amphibian database lists Guibemantis liber in a source measurement table. Its classification fields read order = Anura, family = Mantellidae, genus = Guibemantis; the linked citation is in Reference.csv row 489. The source record marks its mapping to current COL26.8 as unresolved, so this table entry is not a complete species account.
text.zh: 第 3 版 Amphibian database 将 Guibemantis liber 列入来源测量表。其分类字段原样写作 order = Anura, family = Mantellidae, genus = Guibemantis；关联引文见 Reference.csv 第 489 行。来源记录将其与当前 COL26.8 的映射标为“unresolved”，因此这不是完整的物种描述。

title.zh: 记录了哪些测量代码？

text.en: Anura.csv rows 2067, 2068 contain 2 measurement entries; the Sex field records M (male category), F (female category). The source lists 2 table rows; it does not identify unique specimens, so the row count is not an animal count. The populated source codes include SVL: row 2067 (M) = 24.4, row 2068 (F) = 27.42; HL: row 2067 (M) = 6.98, row 2068 (F) = 7.78; HW: row 2067 (M) = 7.5, row 2068 (F) = 8.78; other populated codes are ED, TD, IOD, IND, EN, NS, HAL, FLL, FL, TL, THL, Fin3DW, … (13 entries). These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.
text.zh: Anura.csv 第 2067，2068 行含有 2 条测量记录；Sex 字段记为 M（来源中的雄性类别），F（来源中的雌性类别）。表中共有 2 行，但没有逐行标本编号，因此行数不能当作动物数。来源中有数值的代码包括：SVL：第 2067 行（M）= 24.4；第 2068 行（F）= 27.42；HL：第 2067 行（M）= 6.98；第 2068 行（F）= 7.78；HW：第 2067 行（M）= 7.5；第 2068 行（F）= 8.78；其他有记录的代码为 ED，TD，IOD，IND，EN，NS，HAL，FLL，FL，TL，THL，Fin3DW，…（共 13 项）。这些代码和值按存档内容呈现；数据表没有逐一解释代码。单位未确认，不能据此比较身体大小或作性别鉴别。NA 单元格表示未报告的项目，不证明相应结构不存在。

These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.

title.en: How does the deposit classify this entry?

text.en: The version 3 Amphibian database lists Incilius melanochlorus in a source measurement table. Its classification fields read order = Anura, family = Bufonidae, genus = Incilius; the linked citation is in Reference.csv row 2650. The source record marks its mapping to current COL26.8 as unresolved, so this table entry is not a complete species account.

title.zh: 记录了哪些测量代码？

text.en: Anura.csv rows 2348, 2349 contain 2 measurement entries; the Sex field records M (male category), F (female category). The source lists 2 table rows; it does not identify unique specimens, so the row count is not an animal count. The populated source codes include SVL: row 2348 (M) = 68.6, row 2349 (F) = 73.6; HL: row 2348 (M) = 24.9, row 2349 (F) = 25.5; HW: row 2348 (M) = 26.3, row 2349 (F) = 27.8; other populated codes are TD, FL, TL, TSL. These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.
text.zh: Anura.csv 第 2348，2349 行含有 2 条测量记录；Sex 字段记为 M（来源中的雄性类别），F（来源中的雌性类别）。表中共有 2 行，但没有逐行标本编号，因此行数不能当作动物数。来源中有数值的代码包括：SVL：第 2348 行（M）= 68.6；第 2349 行（F）= 73.6；HL：第 2348 行（M）= 24.9；第 2349 行（F）= 25.5；HW：第 2348 行（M）= 26.3；第 2349 行（F）= 27.8；其他有记录的代码为 TD，FL，TL，TSL。这些代码和值按存档内容呈现；数据表没有逐一解释代码。单位未确认，不能据此比较身体大小或作性别鉴别。NA 单元格表示未报告的项目，不证明相应结构不存在。

text.en: Amphibian morphology version 3 records Leptobrachella jinshaensis under Leptobrachella; family Megophryidae; order Anura. The match to a current COL26.8 species concept remains unresolved, so this page describes the deposited classification rather than making a new taxonomic determination.

title.en: 1 measurement row and 17 populated trait fields

text.en: The source-bound locator is Anura.csv, rows 2568; Reference.csv rows 617; the deposit contains 1 measurement row and 1 bibliography row. Sex values recorded: M. In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 17 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; TD; ETD; IOD; IND; UEW; SL; HAL; LAL; FL; TFL; TL; THL; HLL. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

text.en: The version 3 Amphibian database lists Leptobrachium leishanense in a source measurement table. Its classification fields read order = Anura, family = Megophryidae, genus = Leptobrachium; the linked citation is in Reference.csv row 680. The source record marks its mapping to current COL26.8 as unresolved, so this table entry is not a complete species account.

title.zh: 记录了哪些测量代码？

text.en: Anura.csv rows 2676, 2677 contain 2 measurement entries; the Sex field records M (male category), F (female category). The source lists 2 table rows; it does not identify unique specimens, so the row count is not an animal count. The populated source codes include SVL: row 2676 (M) = 78.7, row 2677 (F) = 69.9; HL: row 2676 (M) = 28.6, row 2677 (F) = 25.2; HW: row 2676 (M) = 32.9, row 2677 (F) = 29; other populated codes are ED, IOD, IND, UEW, SL, HAL, FLL, LAL, FL, TL, TSL, HLL. These source codes and values are reproduced as deposited; the table does not expand every code. Units are not confirmed, so they do not establish comparable body sizes or a sex-based diagnosis. NA cells are unreported entries, not evidence that a structure is absent.

text.en: The source-bound locator is Anura.csv, rows 2678, 2679; Reference.csv rows 681; the deposit contains 2 measurement rows and 1 bibliography row. Sex values recorded: F, M. In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 14 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; IOD; IND; SL; HAL; FLL; LAL; FL; TL; THL; IMT. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

title.en: 2 measurement rows and 11 populated trait fields

text.en: The source-bound locator is Anura.csv, rows 2945, 2946; Reference.csv rows 3068; the deposit contains 2 measurement rows and 1 bibliography row. Sex values recorded: F, M. In the source, F and M label female and male material, J labels juvenile material, and NA means the sex category was not specified. The deposit has 11 populated trait fields: SVL; HL; HW; ED; TD; EN; SL; HAL; FLL; FL; TL. These entries are not a verified count of unique animals. The release does not confirm units for absolute measurements or complete biological coverage; values from different sexes, life stages or studies should not be pooled into one diagnostic size. A missing or NA cell does not establish that a structure was absent.

Absolute units are not confirmed in the deposit, so the recorded dimension values are not used here as a species-wide size range.

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Philautus cornutus within Philautus, Rhacophoridae, and Anura. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 13 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, HL, HW remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are F. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 13 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, HL, HW 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 F。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Pristimantis ardalonychus within Pristimantis, Brachycephaloidea, and Anura. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 10 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, HL, HW remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are F. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 10 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, HL, HW 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 F。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

text.en: The morphology deposit places Pristimantis melanogaster in the source fields Anura / Brachycephaloidea / Pristimantis. It retains 1 measurement row. The source-concept mapping to current COL26.8 taxonomy is unresolved, so this record does not confirm a current accepted species identity.

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Rana tagoi within Rana, Ranidae, and Anura. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Rana tagoi 记在 Rana、Ranidae、Anura 之下。这里保留的是来源自身的分类概念；它与当前 COL26.8 物种概念是否等同尚未解决。原测量单元格、性别代码和书目仍附于此记录。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 2 compiled rows and 7 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, HL, HW remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are F, M. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 2 行记录，其中 7 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, HL, HW 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 F, M。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The source retains 2 measurement rows for this name, with values in 26 measurement fields of the source table. The recorded sex codes are M (male category), F (female category). The measurement unit is not confirmed in this record, so the source values are not presented here as absolute body dimensions. A blank cell means the dataset supplies no value for that field; it does not establish that a body structure is absent.
text.zh: 来源为这一名称保留 2 条测量行，原表中有 26 个测量字段含有数值。性别代码为 M（雄性类别）、F（雌性类别）。本记录未确认测量单位，因此这里不把来源数值写成绝对身体尺寸。空白单元格表示该字段没有数据，并不能证明相应身体结构不存在。

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Sphaerotheca maskeyi within Sphaerotheca, Dicroglossidae, and Anura. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Sphaerotheca maskeyi 记在 Sphaerotheca、Dicroglossidae、Anura 之下。这里保留的是来源自身的分类概念；它与当前 COL26.8 物种概念是否等同尚未解决。原测量单元格、性别代码和书目仍附于此记录。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 26 populated trait columns; labels such as HL, HW, ED remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are M. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 26 个性状列有值；例如 HL, HW, ED 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 M。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

title.en: Rows 5729 and 5730: measurement fields and sex codes
title.zh: 第 5729、5730 行：测量字段与性别代码

text.en: The retained source rows are 5729 (M); 5730 (F). Populated measurement fields are `HL`, `HW`, `ED`, `TD`, `ETD`, `IOD`, `IND`, `UEW`, `EN`, `SL`, `NS`, `HAL`, `FLL`, `TL`, `THL`, `IMT`, `Toe1L`, `Toe2L`, `Toe3L`, `Toe4L`, `Toe5L`, `Fin1L`, `Fin2L`, `Fin3L`, `Fin4L`, `SUL` (26 fields). The abbreviations are dataset field labels; compiled rows are not necessarily distinct specimens and do not by themselves diagnose the species. M and F are the source's male and female categories. The deposit does not confirm absolute length units, so numeric cells are not presented here as comparable dimensions. `NA` cells mean no value was entered, not that an anatomical structure was absent.
text.zh: 保留的来源行为 5729 (M); 5730 (F)。有记录的测量字段为 `HL`, `HW`, `ED`, `TD`, `ETD`, `IOD`, `IND`, `UEW`, `EN`, `SL`, `NS`, `HAL`, `FLL`, `TL`, `THL`, `IMT`, `Toe1L`, `Toe2L`, `Toe3L`, `Toe4L`, `Toe5L`, `Fin1L`, `Fin2L`, `Fin3L`, `Fin4L`, `SUL`（26 个字段）；缩写是数据集的字段名；汇编行不一定对应不同标本，也不能单独诊断物种。M、F 是来源中的雄性与雌性类别；该存档未确认绝对长度单位，因此此处不把数值单元格当作可直接比较的尺寸。 `NA` 单元格表示没有填入数值，不证明相应解剖结构不存在。

text.en: The version 3 morphology deposit places Vietnamophryne occidentalis under Vietnamophryne (Microhylidae; Anura) and retains 1 measurement row with 18 populated trait fields. Source row 6006 (sex code M (male category)) contains entries in `SVL`, `TL`, `HL`. Absolute units are not confirmed in the deposit, so the recorded dimension values are not used here as a species-wide size range.
text.zh: 形态数据第 3 版将 Vietnamophryne occidentalis 归在 Vietnamophryne、Microhylidae、Anura 之下，并保留 1 条测量行，其中 18 个性状字段含有记录。来源第 6006 行（性别代码 M（来源中的雄性类别））在 `SVL`、`TL`、`HL` 字段有记录。存档没有确认绝对测量单位，因此本页不把这些尺寸值解释为物种整体的体型范围。

title.zh: 测量行中有哪些内容

text.en: The rows contain entries in fields such as `SVL`, `TL`, `HL`, `HW`, `ED`, `FLL`, `FL`, `HLL`. M is the source's male category. The row count is not a count of unique specimens. The deposit does not confirm absolute units, and empty cells mean no value was entered for that field.

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Vitreorana baliomma within Vitreorana, Centrolenidae, and Anura. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Vitreorana baliomma 记在 Vitreorana、Centrolenidae、Anura 之下。这里保留的是来源自身的分类概念；它与当前 COL26.8 物种概念是否等同尚未解决。原测量单元格、性别代码和书目仍附于此记录。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 15 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, HL, HW remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are NA. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 15 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, HL, HW 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 NA。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

title.en: Rows 6009: measurement fields and sex codes
title.zh: 第 6009 行：测量字段与性别代码

text.en: The retained source rows are 6009 (M). Populated measurement fields are `SVL`, `HL`, `HW`, `ED`, `TD`, `ETD`, `IOD`, `IND`, `UEW`, `EN`, `SL`, `HAL`, `FLL`, `FL`, `TL`, `Fin1L`, `Fin3DW` (17 fields). The abbreviations are dataset field labels; compiled rows are not necessarily distinct specimens and do not by themselves diagnose the species. M and F are the source's male and female categories. The deposit does not confirm absolute length units, so numeric cells are not presented here as comparable dimensions. `NA` cells mean no value was entered, not that an anatomical structure was absent.
text.zh: 保留的来源行为 6009 (M)。有记录的测量字段为 `SVL`, `HL`, `HW`, `ED`, `TD`, `ETD`, `IOD`, `IND`, `UEW`, `EN`, `SL`, `HAL`, `FLL`, `FL`, `TL`, `Fin1L`, `Fin3DW`（17 个字段）；缩写是数据集的字段名；汇编行不一定对应不同标本，也不能单独诊断物种。M、F 是来源中的雄性与雌性类别；该存档未确认绝对长度单位，因此此处不把数值单元格当作可直接比较的尺寸。 `NA` 单元格表示没有填入数值，不证明相应解剖结构不存在。

title.zh: 存档的形态记录

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Bolitoglossa hypacra within Bolitoglossa, Plethodontidae, and Caudata. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Bolitoglossa hypacra 记在 Bolitoglossa、Plethodontidae、Caudata 之下。这里保留的是来源自身的分类概念；它与当前 COL26.8 物种概念是否等同尚未解决。原测量单元格、性别代码和书目仍附于此记录。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 4 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, AGS, HL remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are F. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 4 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, AGS, HL 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 F。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

title.en: Rows 61: measurement fields and sex codes

text.en: The retained source rows are 61 (F). Populated measurement fields are `SVL`, `AGS`, `HL`, `HW`, `IOD`, `ED`, `UEW`, `IND`, `SL`, `TL`, `TW`, `TAH`, `FLL`, `HLL`, `SF`, `ELL` (16 fields). text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Hynobius tosashimizuensis within Hynobius, Hynobiidae, and Caudata. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 2 compiled rows and 15 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, TRL, AGS remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are M, F. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 2 行记录，其中 15 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, TRL, AGS 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 M, F。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: The source retains 1 measurement row for this name, with values in 18 measurement fields of the source table. The recorded sex code is M (male category). The measurement unit is not confirmed in this record, so the source values are not presented here as absolute body dimensions. A blank cell means the dataset supplies no value for that field; it does not establish that a body structure is absent.

title.zh: 存档的形态记录

text.en: The version 3 deposit lists Pachytriton moi within Pachytriton, Salamandridae, and Caudata. This is the source record’s own taxon concept; its match to a current COL26.8 species remains unresolved. The original measurement cells, sex codes, and bibliography stay attached to this entry.
text.zh: 第 3 版存档将 Pachytriton moi 记在 Pachytriton、Salamandridae、Caudata 之下。这里保留的是来源自身的分类概念；它与当前 COL26.8 物种概念是否等同尚未解决。原测量单元格、性别代码和书目仍附于此记录。

title.zh: 按性别保留的测量材料

text.en: A trait column is one named measurement field. The compilation retains 1 compiled row and 18 populated trait columns; labels such as SVL, TRL, AGS remain in the source shorthand. The recorded sex codes are M. In the source key, F and M denote the source’s female and male categories, J denotes juvenile material, and NA means that the category was unspecified. These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
text.zh: 性状列是表格中的一项测量字段。此汇编保留 1 行记录，其中 18 个性状列有值；例如 SVL, TRL, AGS 仍按来源缩写呈现。记录的性别代码为 M。来源代码中，F 和 M 分别表示来源中的雌性、雄性类别，J 表示幼体，NA 表示未指定类别。行数是汇编记录数，不是去重后的标本数。由于绝对测量单位未确认，不能把不同性别、发育阶段或文献的数值合并为一个诊断尺寸。空白单元格只表示该字段没有提供数值，不能据此认定相应解剖结构不存在。

These are compiled rows, not counts of unique specimens. Absolute measurement units are unconfirmed, so values from different sexes, life stages, or publications are not combined into one diagnostic size. An empty cell means this record supplies no value for that field; it does not show that the corresponding anatomical structure is absent.
